reasoning: This workflow implements an intelligent customer support triage system that classifies incoming emails, automatically responds to FAQ questions, and escalates complex issues to human agents. The system uses AI to understand message intent, sentiment, and confidence level, then either generates automated responses from a FAQ document or notifies support staff for manual handling. This reveals a company focused on scaling customer support efficiently while maintaining quality through smart automation.
name: FairTix Customer Support Triage
businessNarrative: This workflow processes support emails for FairTix, a fair ticket marketplace, by classifying them into categories (FAQ, Account/Verification, Payment/Billing, Technical/Bug, Resale/Transfer, Feedback) and analyzing sentiment. FAQ questions receive automated AI-generated responses based on a master FAQ document, while complex issues are escalated to human agents with pre-classified context. This enables FairTix to handle high support volumes efficiently while ensuring critical issues get human attention, reducing response times and operational costs.
trigger: New support email received in Gmail inbox
dataFlow: Support emails enter from Gmail, get classified by AI into categories with sentiment analysis, are logged to Google Sheets for tracking, and either receive automated responses (FAQ category) or human escalation notifications (all other categories)

impact.reasoning: This directly impacts customer experience and satisfaction, which is critical for a marketplace business. Poor support response times or quality could lead to lost customers, negative reviews, and reduced trust in the platform. The 43 executions with 0% error rate suggest stability.
impact.failureScenario: Support emails go unanswered, FAQ questions require manual responses increasing workload, complex issues lack proper classification leading to slower resolution times

detectability.reasoning: Support team would notice if they start receiving unclassified tickets or customers complain about no responses. The Google Sheets logging provides an audit trail.
detectability.failureScenario: Support team notices increase in direct emails or customers complain about lack of response
